entries.value: "The record STAMP shared by every bsc store (#72) — rev, author, timestamp, per-write history, and the retained rungs `revert` reads. Lifted out of bsc-component so the algorithms graph stamps writes the SAME way rather than growing a second implementation that drifts."

lead: # build.rs parses the committed graph store directly — see crates/graph-materialize/build.rs.
# The epoch↔ISO clock pair. bsc-util is the dependency-free leaf, so this stays a two-dep crate.
# For `record_source` only. bsc-record is depended on by just bsc-graph and bsc-component, so this
# stays narrow — bsc-util would have put regex into 36 of 40 crates' rebuild scope.
# serde_json only. This is deliberately NOT in `bsc-util`: that crate's contract is "std only, no
# dependencies, so any CLI can pull it in for free", and adding serde_json would quietly break it.
